description: Search Google Flights live via SerpAPI. Returns best_flights and other_flights (each with legs, airlines, times, duration, layovers, price and carbon emissions), plus price_insights and airport info. Supports round trip (type=1, needs return_date), one way (type=2) and multi-city (type=3 via multi_city_json). Two-step flows: pass a departure_token from a prior result to get the returning flights / next leg, or a booking_token to get booking options — re-send the original search params alongside either token. Prices are in `currency` (default USD). IDs are AIRPORT codes, never city/metro codes: TYO, NYC, LON, PAR, MIL, ROM, OSA, CHI, WAS return NO results (live-verified) — send the airports instead (TYO → 'HND,NRT'; NYC → 'JFK,EWR,LGA'; LON → 'LHR,LGW,STN,LTN'; PAR → 'CDG,ORY'; MIL → 'MXP,LIN,BGY'; ROM → 'FCO,CIA') or the city's Google kgmid (e.g. '/m/07dfk' for Tokyo). Result shape: { note?, source, fetchedAt, query, search_metadata: { google_flights_url }, search_parameters, best_flights: [...], other_flights: [...], price_insights, airports } — the two itinerary lists are `best_flights` and `other_flights` (there is no `flights` or `deals` key at the top level, and an itinerary is never a bare flight). Each itinerary: { flights: [{ departure_airport: { name, id, time }, arrival_airport: { name, id, time }, duration, airplane, airline, airline_logo, travel_class, flight_number, legroom, extensions }], layovers: [{ duration, name, id, overnight }], total_duration, carbon_emissions, price, type, airline_logo, departure_token, booking_token } — `price` is the whole-itinerary price in `currency`, `duration`/`total_duration` are minutes, and the per-leg times are local 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' strings. Feed `departure_token` back for the return leg and `booking_token` for booking options. A top-level `note` appears only when stops=1 found no nonstop flight and the server retried without the stop filter: the itineraries are then connecting flights, and their tokens need the same params re-sent without `stops` — tell the user that no direct flights were found and connecting flights are shown.

arrival_id.description: Arrival AIRPORT IATA code(s) (e.g. 'HND,NRT') or a Google location kgmid (e.g. '/m/07dfk' for Tokyo). Comma-separate multiple. NOT a city/metro code — TYO, LON, PAR, MIL, ROM, OSA return no results; list the airports instead.

booking_token.description: Token from a prior result, used to fetch booking options for a selected itinerary. Re-send the same search params alongside it. Mutually exclusive with departure_token.

currency.description: Currency of returned prices (ISO code, e.g. 'USD', 'EUR'). Default USD.

deep_search.description: Run a deeper search that matches the Google Flights browser results more closely (slower). Default false.

departure_id.description: Departure AIRPORT IATA code(s) (3-letter, uppercase, e.g. 'WAW' or 'WAW,WMI') or a Google location kgmid (/m/… or /g/…). Comma-separate multiple. NOT a city/metro code — TYO, NYC, LON, PAR, MIL, ROM return no results; list the airports instead (NYC → 'JFK,EWR,LGA'). Used for type 1/2; for multi-city (type 3) use multi_city_json instead.

departure_token.description: Token from a prior result, used to select an outbound flight and fetch the returning flights (round trip) or the next leg (multi-city). Re-send the same search params alongside it. Mutually exclusive with booking_token.

emissions.description: Emissions filter: 1 = less emissions only. Omit for no filter.

exclude_airlines.description: Exclude these airlines: comma-separated 2-letter IATA codes, or an alliance (STAR_ALLIANCE, SKYTEAM, ONEWORLD). Mutually exclusive with include_airlines.

exclude_basic.description: Exclude basic-economy fares. Only for domestic US flights with travel_class=1. Default false.

exclude_conns.description: Connecting airports to exclude: comma-separated 3-letter IATA codes (e.g. 'CDG,LHR').

gl.description: Country code for the search, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'de'.

include_airlines.description: Only these airlines: comma-separated 2-letter IATA codes, or an alliance: STAR_ALLIANCE, SKYTEAM, ONEWORLD. Mutually exclusive with exclude_airlines.

infants_in_seat.description: Number of infants in seat. Default 0.

infants_on_lap.description: Number of infants on lap. Default 0.

layover_duration.description: Layover duration range in minutes, 'min,max' (e.g. '90,330' for 1.5-5.5h).

max_duration.description: Maximum total trip duration in minutes (e.g. 1500 for 25h).

max_price.description: Maximum ticket price in the selected currency.

multi_city_json.description: Multi-city itinerary (required when type=3): a JSON-string array of legs, e.g. '[{"departure_id":"CDG","arrival_id":"NRT","date":"2026-06-27"},{"departure_id":"NRT","arrival_id":"LAX","date":"2026-07-03"}]'. Each leg may include an optional "times" field (same format as outbound_times).

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

outbound_times.description: Outbound time window as comma-separated hours (0-23). 2 values = departure range 'min,max' (e.g. '4,18'); 4 values add an arrival range (e.g. '4,18,3,19').

return_date.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when type=1 (round trip).

return_times.description: Return time window, same format as outbound_times. Only valid when type=1.

show_hidden.description: Include hidden flight results. Default false.

sort_by.description: Sort order: 1 = top flights (default), 2 = price, 3 = departure time, 4 = arrival time, 5 = duration, 6 = emissions.

stops.description: Max stops: 0 = any (default), 1 = nonstop only, 2 = 1 stop or fewer, 3 = 2 stops or fewer. When stops=1 finds no nonstop flight, the server automatically retries without the filter and returns connecting flights with a `note`; send a departure_token/booking_token from those with the same params but no stops.

travel_class.description: Travel class: 1 = economy (default), 2 = premium economy, 3 = business, 4 = first.

type.description: Trip type: 1 = round trip (default), 2 = one way, 3 = multi-city.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: google_flights_search

note.description: Present only when stops=1 found no nonstop flight and best_flights/other_flights are connecting flights from a search without the stop filter. Tell the user that no direct flights were found, so connecting flights are shown.

title: Search Google Flights (SerpAPI)
